DGowdru Admin - License Manager Guide

* Double-click Key_Manager.exe to manage your customer licenses
* Press '1' to generate a Permanent Key (locks to a customer's specific PC forever)
* Press '2' to generate a 1-Use Key (gives the customer 1 run, then burns the key)
* Press '3' to initialize your Universal Trial Key (DGowdru-UNIVERSAL)
* Give the 'User_Guide.txt' and 'Description_Writer_Protected.exe' to your customers
* DO NOT give your customers the Key_Manager.exe file
